status: preregistered synthetic engine-integration fixture; no measured trajectory or candidate comparison

source.citation: Vahrmeijer, J.T., Annandale, J.G., Steyn, J.M. and Bristow, K.L. (2018), Model parameters of four important vegetable crops for improved water use and yield estimation, Water SA 44(4), 528–538.
source.sourceParameterTable: Table 6 selected winter broccoli SWB parameter set
source.tableDiscrepancy: Table 5 measured winter Parthenon K_PAR=1.14 and Table 6 selected winter broccoli K_PAR=1.09. Table 5 summer Star 2204 K_PAR=1.09 and Table 6 selected summer broccoli K_PAR=1.14. Values are preserved separately; no biological attribution is inferred.
domainLimits: These selected values are not generic broccoli defaults or a complete FarmFriend parameter set.
The source RUE uses intercepted total solar radiation and cannot be copied into FarmFriend's intercepted-PAR RUE equation.
The source p/SLA relation calculates LAI from canopy dry matter; it does not define the daily share of new net dry matter allocated to canopy versus harvestable organs.

modelDispatch.historicalVersions: crop-model-v1, v2 and v3 retain their existing equations and frozen-input interpretation; ordinary new-run creation remains v1 until acceptance gates pass.

fixtureClassification: synthetic software integration only; not a source reproduction, measured comparison, reference-model agreement, or crop prediction

frozenSyntheticInputs.allocationConstraint: Canopy and harvestable shares are synthetic frozen assumptions, sum to exactly 1, and partition each net DM increment once. No harvest-index multiplier is applied on top of the harvestable pool.
frozenSyntheticInputs.interceptionTiming: Compute LAI and FI_PAR from the frozen beginning-of-day canopy DM; use that same fraction for the day's photosynthesis, then partition the resulting net DM gain. Do not feed the same day's gain into that day's interception.

equationArithmeticTolerance.units: LAI m²/m²; FI_PAR dimensionless; net DM g/m²/day
equationArithmeticTolerance.basis: Synthetic deterministic arithmetic check with frozen displayed source transcriptions; not biological or predictive accuracy.

dryMatterClosureTolerance.residual: total dry-matter increment minus canopy increment minus harvestable increment
dryMatterClosureTolerance.basis: Numerical conservation invariant for each partitioned daily net-production increment.

acceptanceChecks.zeroLight: Exactly zero photosynthetic gain in both canopy and harvestable pools when DLI is known zero.
acceptanceChecks.unknownLight: No DM pool changes when DLI is unknown; output is qualified as unsupported for that day's production.

qualification: The source K_PAR/SLA/p values are source-selected seasonal references; the Table 5/Table 6 K_PAR discrepancy is disclosed without attribution.
The intercepted-PAR RUE, 0.6/0.4 daily canopy/harvestable allocation, and initial per-cell pool values are synthetic assumptions, not source parameters.

The source RUE and water/climate equations are not transferred. Root-zone transpiration remains FAO-56 potential ET with Ks-limited actual uptake and production stress. Enclosure transpiration remains a lagged potential-ET proxy using frozen Kc and previous climate ET factor; current Ks is not coupled into enclosure flux. Dynamic FI_PAR is only a qualified canopy-cover proxy for enclosure exchange.
This fixture does not validate broccoli growth, harvest timing, water response, or model accuracy.

toleranceReview.requestedScope: Equation arithmetic, zero/unknown light behavior, and two-pool daily dry-matter closure only. No measured or candidate comparison is authorized.

implementationStatus: not implemented; no candidate comparison run
